en.content: A heat engine absorbs heat Q<sub>1</sub> at temperature T<sub>1</sub> and heat Q<sub>2</sub> at temperature T<sub>2</sub>. Work done by the engine is J (Q<sub>1</sub> + Q<sub>2</sub>). This data :

options.content: violates 1<sup>st</sup> law of thermodynamics
violates 1<sup>st</sup> law of thermodynamics if Q<sub>1</sub> is +ve
violates 1<sup>st</sup> law of thermodynamics if Q<sub>1</sub> is -ve
does not violates 1<sup>st</sup> law of thermodynamics

en.explanation:
According to first law of thermodynamics energy can neither be created nor destroyed although it can be converted from one form to another.

NOTE : Carnot cycle is based upon this principle but during the conversion of heat into work some mechanical energy is always converted to other form of energy hence this data violates st. law of thermodynamics.
